# Finish Workstation as a compact composition entrypoint

## Context

After optional demo execution and docking-policy ownership leave the root, the remaining entrypoint must actually meet the operator's adoption bar. Existing FeedPane/ScalePane, model.Record, Feed/Scale stores and WorkspaceController provide ordinary Neo homes; paneStories, resident markup, feed production/status and composition are still embedded in Workspace.

This is a leaf of the dedicated Workstation consumer-refactoring epic. The shared outcome is a ≤1,000-total-line composition entrypoint with working ordinary docking and optional scripted demos.

## The Problem

The named responsibility currently lives on `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs`, coupling its state, caller surface and teardown to the root. This leaf removes that responsibility and updates its actual callers in the same PR; it does not create a forwarding method for every moved member.

## The Architectural Reality

Placement pre-flight: new pane/view classes match FeedPane/ScalePane in apps/workstation/view; controllers match WorkspaceController; data owners use existing model/store domains and root state.Provider. No replacement app framework or new top-level subsystem is needed.

## The Fix

Complete app-owned pane/view/data composition using the existing class families. Keep one root provider and the same Store<Model> identities; move resident presentation into a named view and live-data production into its appropriate app data owner. Use `examples/dashboard/dock/MainContainer.mjs` (609 total lines at the source check) as the entrypoint shape: declare zones, panes, tabs, widget registration, default layout and engine capabilities as data/config. Apply that example's existing document/config idiom. New declarative configuration schemas or automatic lifecycle-owner construction belong to the separately scoped Ideation Sandbox, not this leaf. The extracted owners hold actual behavior—live-data production, vessel policy, scripted gestures and tour settlement—with optional demo activation and only a few justified product hooks on the root. Update the app README to show ordinary use and optional tour activation, and measure the final entrypoint rather than accepting the sum of earlier deletions.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Entry definition | Operator 500–1000 target; current Workspace composition | At most 1,000 total source lines, readable without inspecting demo drivers | No feature deletion to pass | App README and local JSDoc | Physical-line measurement plus ordinary-use journey |
| Pane/provider/feed ownership | Existing FeedPane/ScalePane, root stateProvider and app stores | Same live panes/stores and one producer; normal Neo views/data owners | Existing recreate/restore behavior | Owner JSDoc | Identity, feed and repeated recreate/restore controls |
| Integrated product | Existing Workstation behavior and prior leaves | Normal docking and explicit tours both remain usable | Existing honest failure states | Updated adoption example | Selected final-head end-to-end journeys |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Workspace.mjs is ≤1,000 total physical source lines (500–1,000 expected, no padding floor). It declares the dock document, pane catalog and engine capabilities with short justified hooks; it uses existing engine defaults and does not contain moved executors or controller state.
- [ ] No new or modified app module exceeds 2,000 total lines. Useful documentation remains; all responsibility moves and retained hooks are accounted for, with no wrapper-per-method or generic helper monolith.
- [ ] Normal boot/docking, pin/reveal, pane recreation, cross-window return, undo/redo and warm/cold saved-layout paths work without activating the demo runtime.
- [ ] The feed retains its declared rate/cap and one producer; pane/store identities survive normal docking and restoration. Cleanup releases owned resources without disposing borrowed ones.
- [ ] Explicitly activated dense tour and the existing five-beat executable journey retain their assertions; this does not claim whole-media/human film approval or close its separate gate.
- [ ] The app README demonstrates the compact ordinary composition and identifies optional demo ownership. Final-head unit and selected existing E2E receipts cover the moved concerns; record the final line measurement.

## Out of Scope

Repository-wide lint changes, new general guide series, product redesign, reduced demo workload, and closure of unrelated engine/canvas/film defects.

## Avoided Traps

No giant helper or copied post-setup factory descriptors; no shadow Group/document registry; no feature removal or weakened assertions to meet the size bar. Preserve explicit creator/borrower cleanup. Existing defects require baseline attribution rather than a false green.

## Decision Record impact

Aligned with ADR 0029; preserves existing engine operation, Group, projection and native-window contracts. Any required engine-contract change must be separately authorized and linked before this leaf merges.

### @neo-gpt-emmy - 2026-09-08T23:54:05Z

The remaining work is materially larger than the pane/feed extraction named in this leaf. I measured the current source and the pending cuts before treating this as the final cleanup.

| Workspace source | Physical lines | State at this check |
|---|---:|---|
| `dev@335b2ca43a` | 3,042 | Landed |
| PR #18496 at `16fa13d3c3` | 2,501 | Approved, unmerged |
| Prospective #18496 + #18510 (`3ae4bcdc33`) + draft #18499 (`45b57120f1`) | 2,433 | In-memory source composition only |

The prospective file has 65 method definitions and parses with Acorn. I resolved the import collision by retaining TourToolbar, WindowManager and CrossWindowGestureSnapshot, and the end-of-class collision by retaining the playback removal of getGestureDriver and the snapshot extraction. No branch or working file changed. The playback/route merge also conflicts in the generated size baseline. This is a scope measurement, **not** an integrated runtime receipt or credit for draft work. The resolved source SHA-256 is `5c158b1740554b4eac171caf9735787b41e93caaedebd7ca85f7fc32784d917c`.

The nine named pane/feed/status methods occupy **185 lines including their immediately attached JSDoc**; the paneStories declaration adds 20 source lines. Those extents are an inventory, not a promised deletion. They cannot account for the prospective **1,433-line gap** to the ceiling. Native vessel, participation, projection and Group integration still need the responsibility-by-responsibility disposition already required by #18460; moving the remaining code into a helper would not finish #18456.

The app-owned slice does have concrete existing contracts:

- Resident presentation can use an ordinary view; retain canonical pane/header text and the resident CSS structure.
- Feed production currently seeds 25 records and adds five every 500 ms. The Feed store declares the 500-record cap, while Workspace enforces it. Keep one producer, monotonic sequence, the same Store<Model> identity, and stop production before the root provider retires.
- Pane caching/recreation and popup borrowing preserve the same live instances. Tour receipts also read feed counters; the sparkline pulse combines a live grid/canvas cell with record mutation and cannot simply be classified as feed production.
- Status borrows store truth; it must not become another collection or provider owner.

**Disposition:** keep the existing leaf and its ≤1,000-line acceptance criterion. Complete/link the remaining engine prerequisites under their existing authority, then measure the integrated consumer again. The newer declarative configuration design remains separately scoped. No new ticket, implementation reservation, reduced workload or lowered size bar follows from this assessment.
